artDirection: Aergyle grounded full-body NPCs with visual storytelling

assets.name: Ossa
assets.complexion: Light warm skin with a weathered ruddy forge-worker complexion
assets.socialStatus: Respected municipal master artisan who rejects guild prestige
assets.lifestyle: A dawn-working bridge-forge smith who maintains old tools and serves labourers before prestigious clients.
assets.experience: Decades of civic ironwork, bridge-chain repair, and emergency forge work.
habits: mends his own apron in indigo thread
ties back his shoulder-length iron-grey hair
binds the lower third of his great work beard in plain iron bands
keeps a child's horseshoe charm at his belt
assets.history: He survived a bridge-chain failure during a flood, kept the forge operating through the night, and left after guild masters claimed the credit.
assets.revision: Changed from a human woman to a male dwarf, then revised to light weathered skin, abundant shoulder-length hair, and a substantially fuller beard while preserving the original visual story.

assets.name: Varka Ten-Reeds
assets.profession: Hunter, tracker, guide, and antler trader
assets.socialStatus: Locally respected independent guide and outsider in Crown cities
assets.lifestyle: A light-footed frontier merchant who sells antlers, hides, repaired arrows, and reliable trail knowledge.
assets.experience: Former Crown trail scout with expert knowledge of flooded woods and seasonal reed paths.
habits: consults a compass with no needle
assets.history: After Crown officials abandoned her patrol during flood season, she filed their crest from her badge and mapped safe routes for fair-paying travellers.

assets.name: Pello Nacre
assets.appearance: Light-skinned white Caucasian man with a fair, weathered ruddy coastal complexion and a comfortably rounded cook's belly
assets.lifestyle: A former galley cook who buys his own market produce, maintains fine working knives, and serves practical fish dishes from a permanent stall.
assets.experience: A lifetime cooking in cramped galleys, during a shipwreck, and for a busy city market.
habits: balances like the floor is a deck
pinches salt by hand at the final moment
assets.history: He cooked the last shared meal after a Farwater wreck and later built a Crownhold soup stall from salvaged galley boards.
assets.revision: Redesigned primarily around a light-skinned Caucasian face and added a modestly larger rounded belly while preserving the original visual story.

runtimeExport: ffmpeg Lanczos resize from 1024x1536 to 512x768 with RGBA preserved
validation: All masters and runtime exports are RGBA PNGs.
The upper-left 64x64 corner of every master has alpha minimum, average, and maximum equal to zero.
No generated source was used outside this pack without a project-local copy.
